hook: A coach records how many minutes each of 14 players warmed up. One player warmed up for 45 minutes. Should the report give the mean or the median? The answer depends on what each summary does with that one value.

prereq.q: Which describes the shape of a distribution with a long tail to the right?
prereq.why: A distribution is skewed toward its long tail.

chain.effect: one very large value pulls it up

chain.cause: The median only needs the middle of the ordered list
chain.effect: it barely moves when one value grows

chain.cause: So in skewed data with outliers
chain.effect: the median and IQR describe the typical value and spread better

ideas: The median and IQR are resistant; the mean, range and standard deviation are not.
An outlier lies more than $1.5 \times \text{IQR}$ beyond a quartile.

misconception.wrong: The mean is always the best center.
misconception.right: In strongly skewed data, or with outliers, the median describes a typical value better.

summary: The mean and standard deviation use every value, so outliers pull them; the median and IQR resist outliers. The $1.5 \times \text{IQR}$ rule flags outliers.
